'''Afterthought''' was one of the two main continents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ropagi II]], located in the western hemisphere.

==Description==
Like most of Ropagi II's surface, Afterthought was dominated by flat plains and large urban centers. The cities [[Tev (city)|Tev]] and [[Kaloder]] were located here. The cities were connected to the rest of the world by a [[skyshuttle]] system. As the name implied, the Ropagu who oriented their thoughts towards the preservation of the past lived on this continent. Ironically, the [[Great Library]], which collected most of Ropagi II's history, was located on the other continent, [[Forethought]].<ref name="Twin Stars" />
